# Aden Ramirez Portfolio

> Public portfolio for Aden Ramirez, a computer science student and software engineer in El Paso, Texas.

Canonical site: https://aden-ramirez-portfolio.onrender.com

## Main pages

- / — overview and selected work
- /work — complete public project archive
- /jobs — employment history
- /education — UTEP education and coursework
- /about — background and working style
- /contact — professional contact information and resume
- /sitemap.xml — complete index of public routes and project case studies

## Public data

- /api/profile — public profile data
- /api/projects — public project data

Content may be summarized with attribution. Private repository files and non-public data are not part of this site.
